0022600113.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-2, 12th in the East, 5th in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back) host the Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back) in the Nets' third game of the 2026-27 season. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (out, rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (day-to-day, shoulder, game-time decision), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (out, hamstring), with Aaron Nesmith day-to-day (hamstring strain, game-time decision). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Nets lost 1-2, most recently 123-94 in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
